case_selection: Three datasets used in the article; 4 splits per dataset (full plus holdout_0..2), evaluated at K=1,2,3. All 36 real-data cases are listed in case_manifest.json.
indexing: row_index is zero-based; source_row_id is the one-based row number in the frozen source. WDBC source_id is the public source archive ID, excluded from model features.
labels: Labels are external evaluation columns only. Exclude labels, row indices and source IDs from feature matrices.
preprocessing: Training-only mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0); Seeds and WDBC projected onto 3 leading unwhitened principal components. Faithful retains both standardized coordinates. SVD signs fixed by making each component largest absolute loading positive. Downstream FMVMM fitting also uses its common training-only whitening transformation; the model_space files are inputs to that step.
holdout_rule: np.random.default_rng(split_seed).permutation(n); first ceil(0.2*n) rows are test, remainder training; each index vector sorted. No stratification or label use.
floating_point_format: 17 significant decimal digits, sufficient to round-trip IEEE float64 values.

faithful.citation: R Core Team and contributors (R 4.5.1), datasets::faithful; source W. Härdle, Smoothing Techniques with Implementation in S (1991).
faithful.row_policy: all rows, original source order; no imputation, deletion, jitter or subsampling
faithful.notes: Unlabelled Old Faithful eruption/waiting measurements, as bundled in R 4.5.1. Rounded values are retained. Random holdouts assess interpolation of the empirical density, not temporal forecasting or independent future eruptions.

preprocessing.standardization: training mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0)
preprocessing.pca_dimension_rule: Faithful: both coordinates; Seeds, WDBC, Wholesale: three leading PCs
preprocessing.density_note: Predictive scores are densities in the fixed modeled feature space. PCA projections do not define a density in the complete original feature space.
